label: Aqit
note: Bedouin: milk churned in a goatskin, the buttermilk heated until it curdles, curd shaped into discs and dried in the shade at least a day; some accounts make it from boiled yoghurt instead (sources differ)

about.text: A dried dairy product of the Arabian Bedouin: churned buttermilk is heated until it curdles and the curd is dried into hard discs that keep for months.

how.label: churn, heat, dry
how.text: Milk churned in a goatskin (qirba), butter taken off, the buttermilk heated until it thickens, then shaped into discs and dried on cloth in the shade.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Milk is churned in a goatskin (qirba) and the butter taken off.
The buttermilk is heated until it thickens.
